why: Chang and Sun (GD 2024) proved Harborth's conjecture for the case of 4-regular planar graphs, settling a specific class not previously known; separately, 2026 preprints ('On the Harborth Conjecture Part I') make incremental progress on a related strengthening (Kleber's conjecture) via rational-distance lemmas for small polygons. Note the unrelated 'matchstick graph edge-count' Harborth conjecture (solved by Lavollée and Swanepoel) is a different problem and not this one.
